stories.title: Jakupovic v. Intact Insurance Company, 2026 ONCA 651 (CanLII)
stories.summary: Insurance — Accident benefits — Statutory Accident Benefits Schedule, O. Reg. 34/10 — Section 34 relief for late notice — Whether claimant had a reasonable explanation for non-compliance — Licence Appeal Tribunal finding explanation neither credible nor reasonable — No basis to relieve from s. 32(1) time requirement — Appeal allowed, LAT decision restored Statutory interpretation — Modern principle — Statutory Accident Benefits Schedule, O. Reg. 34/10, s. 32(1) — Whether reporting an accident satisfies notice of intention to apply for benefits — Text, context and purpose and “text remains the anchor” — Divisional Court found to have rewritten statutory requirements — Appeal allowed, Divisional Court set aside Procedure — Appeals — Licence Appeal Tribunal Act, 1999, s. 11(6) — Question of law only — Whether Divisional Court exceeded proper appellate review by making findings of fact — Substitution of broad factual findings contrary to LAT findings — Standard of review correctness on statutory interpretation — Appeal allowed, LAT decision restored Procedure — Procedural fairness — Appellate record — Whether Divisional Court erred by referencing medical evidence that post-dated the LAT decision — Use of post-decision evidence found procedurally unfair — Scope of appeal confined to questions of law — Decision of Divisional Court set aside — Appeal allowed, LAT decision restored
